about.headingPrefix: I'm Rehema Manuella Wanjiru and I am a
about.body:
Innovative Software Developer and AI researcher based in Nairobi, Kenya. I hold a strong academic and practical foundation in Computer Science, with focused experience in AI model development, digital security systems, and software engineering.

I build practical solutions that bridge advanced technology and real-world impact, including bias detection, resilient tracking systems, and intelligent scheduling tools.

Beyond technical delivery, I bring leadership experience from serving as President of the Strathmore Japanese Club and volunteering with the Embassy of Japan in Kenya, where I have helped connect technology, culture, and community engagement.

projects.title: Secure Cloud Web Hosting
projects.tech: CentOS, Apache, PHP, MariaDB, Certbot, DNS, Google Cloud
projects.description: Hosted a PHP and MariaDB web application on a cloud-hosted CentOS server, secured with HTTPS.
projects.problem: Take a web application from code to a secure, reachable service on a cloud server, and keep it working when things break.
actions: Configured Apache virtual hosts and document roots, DNS and subdomains, and firewall rules
Enabled HTTPS with a Certbot SSL certificate
Implemented secure password hashing in PHP and fixed login and signup failures caused by schema and hashing errors
Diagnosed permission-denied errors (chown/chmod), SSL configuration faults, and DNS propagation and connectivity problems

results.label: fault types diagnosed: permissions, SSL, DNS

projects.title: Consistent-Hashing Load Balancer
projects.tech: Python, Flask, Docker Compose, REST API
projects.description: A containerised load balancer that spreads requests across servers and drops a failed server without interrupting service.
projects.problem: Spread requests evenly across servers, and keep the service running when a server stops.
actions: Built a Python/Flask load balancer on Docker Compose with a 512-slot hash ring, virtual nodes and a REST API to add and remove servers
Implemented heartbeat monitoring that detected a stopped server and removed it from the ring
Load-tested with 10,000 requests and diagnosed a 96% load skew
Redesigned the hash function using MD5 and virtual nodes
